skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Summer Flowers FA161
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA161. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
skins.quote: The starlit sky reflects on the waves, while ashen bones scare away souls.

skins.name: As Clear As Crystal
skins.content: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/As Clear As Crystal. Necrass's dress for the musical. The inner lining bedecked with stars is the abyss of the past, the radiant outer surface the resolute present. Through crystal and steel, her will carries on.
skins.quote: O lost traveler, no longer must you waver before the unseen roads ahead. Follow in her footsteps, and look towards her light.
